gallery.title: Clips
gallery.empty: No clips yet. Press Start and save with the hotkey.
gallery.coming: Gallery arrives in Phase 2–3. This is the Phase 1 shell.

audio.title: Capture audio
audio.no_signal: No signal from the selected device
audio.save_tracks_note: Saved clips carry 3 tracks: Mix, Game, Mic. Mix is first and the only enabled one by default.
audio.single_track_hint: Maximum compatibility: any player plays the Mix. The file loses the Game and Mic tracks.
audio.single_track_note: Saved clips will carry only the Mix track, playable in any player.
audio.stopped_hint: Start the buffer to link audio tracks.
audio.gain_live: Applies live while the buffer runs; otherwise on the next start.

video.title: Recording video
video.portal_note: No screen chosen yet: the system picker (Portal) opens once on the first start.
video.custom_title: Every engine video-output option: encoder, quality and the Video tab. Auto values are decided by the engine.
video.custom_unvalidated: Family without live validation on this machine: starts on Automatic. Use “Test 10 s” to validate your settings.
video.ram_low: Warning: estimated RAM exceeds your free RAM minus 1 GB.
video.upscale_warn: Above your monitor: heavier file, zero extra detail.
video.restart_notice: Changing preset, custom settings, monitor, duration or container restarts the buffer with a notice. Mixer volume applies live.

obs.title: Capture engine (isolated)
obs.subtitle: MoonClip records with its own embedded engine in its own folder. Nothing else on your system is touched.
obs.repaired: Engine config regenerated. It applies the next time the buffer starts.
obs.missing: The embedded engine copy was not found.
obs.missing_hint: Source: {{source}}. Reinstall MoonClip or run the fetch script.
obs.anti_cheat: System-level capture, no game hooks: anti-cheat compatible (Vanguard, VAC, FACEIT…).

settings.hotkey_needs_mod: Use a modifier (Ctrl/Alt/Shift/Super) or a function key (F1–F12).

secret.title: Secret vault (OS keyring)
secret.ok: Vault OK: store → read → delete succeeded.

games.picker_note: Running-process picker and click-to-register arrive in Phase 4.

wizard.title: Pick your moon
wizard.subtitle: We detected your GPU and suggest a preset. You can change it anytime in Settings.
wizard.ram_note: Estimated cost with a 30 s buffer: ~{{ram}} MB of RAM.
wizard.test_hint: Records {{seconds}} s, saves the clip and validates it. Your configuration is not changed.
wizard.portal_pick: First run: the system asks which screen to share (once). Pick your monitor and mark Remember.
wizard.test_ok: It works! {{height}}p @ {{fps}} fps · test clip ≈ {{size}} MB
wizard.custom_note: Want to fine-tune? Settings → Video (custom mode: bitrate and FPS).
